title: 10 stars for a fantastic evening out!
text: This was an absolute delight! Learning how to cook paella was secondary to meeting new friends and having fun conversing with them. We enjoyed multiple different paella dishes and they were all amazing! Alejandro and Kevin were excellent hosts and made the evening immensely fun! We would do this class again in a heartbeat!!
author: Michele_L

title: Highly recommend! Must do
text: I cannot recommend the Paella Club more! We had the best time and actually made a delicious paella! Each step was explained and shown what to do. If I could give it 100 stars I would! Highly recommend!
author: Amy_B

title: Just go!
text: The Paella class was the best part of our trip to Barcelona. Alex is so fun and really knows what he’s doing. Valentina and Cesar were great, too. We drank, we ate, we drank some more. Don’t miss it!
author: Jen_D

title: Best experience in Barcelona
text: This was my 2nd time going to the Paella Club and is a place I will always visit every time I come to Barcelona.  The first time I did the cooking class was in 2023 and it was the highlight of the trip.  Three years later I returned to Barcelona and the first thing I booked was The Paella Club and then the Sagrada Familia!  The owner, Alex is absolutely amazing and his energy and passion for what he does makes the entire experience.  You get good music, amazing Paella, cava overflowing and great fellowship! It’s a MUST DO when in Barcelona so don’t miss it!
author: 407shantej

title: Don’t miss this when visiting Barcelona!
text:
Pure fun, learned to cook paella with confidence, LOVED the friendly atmosphere!
Would love to do it again!!
author: Donna_B

title: Super fun experience!
text:
Amazing experience from start to finish! The hosts were super friendly and made the whole class really fun and interactive. We all cooked different types of paella and then enjoyed them together with plenty of wine, music and good vibes. 🍷🥘

You learn a lot and have a great time. They even send you the recipes afterwards. Would 100% recommend this if you’re in Barcelona!
author: 453femkep

title: Awesome event
text: Incredible experience, very nice ambiance, a cheerful Kevin… everything very, very good… absolute recommendation
author: thomasmK580HR

title: Paella cooking class in Barcelona
text: Loads of fun, interactive, learned a lot about paella which all were really yummy. Host was brilliant, made the night.
author: Vanessa_A

title: Awesome Experience!
text: Everything was great & the 6 of us had a lot of fun! Learned to cook & make sangria. Made friends along the way. Some of us thought the protein portion was a bit small. The vegetarians did not mind that aspect! Would definitely recommend!
author: mppsyd97

title: Tons of fun!!
text: We were a group of 7 who took an afternoon class on July 16, 2026. We had an amazing time!! The 2hr cooking experience with Cava flowing the entire class was so much fun!! The paella, drinks and music as well as the atmosphere outstanding. Our instructor Susana (I hope I got her name right) and her assistant were great and tons of fun! I will definitely recommend to everyone that this is a must when visiting Barcelona and I would come again!
author: cmench
